final: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN p.ID END) FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5) > (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN p.ID END) FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5) THEN 'False' ELSE 'False' END as answer
